messages:
ash: Heads up — PR #4821 CI is red on linux-py39-unit, looks like a flaky network timeout in test_job_queue. Seen in run https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/12345 :confused:
ci-bot: Build 12345 finished — job "linux-py39-unit" failed (exit 1). Quick log snippet: `TimeoutError: RPC call timed out after 10s`
lina: If it's only that one job we can target a lightweight retrigger (no image rebuild). Two options I use: 
```
./tools/ci retry-job --id=12345 --task=linux-py39-unit --no-image
# or via GH Actions
gh run rerun 12345 --job "linux-py39-unit"
```
sam: Do we want to rerun once or a couple times before escalating/bisecting? Sometimes one retry clears flakiness.
miguel: +1 to try a single targeted retry first. If it flakes consistently, consider `--rerun-count=3` or preserve caches with `--preserve-cache`. For reproducible failure then `./tools/ci bisect --job=linux-py39-unit --commit-range=HEAD~50..HEAD` is the next step.
ash: (typo) ash: running the retry now: `./tools/ci retry-job --id=12345 --task=linux-py39-unit --no-image` — will report back here. :thumbsup:
lina: also left a note on the PR suggesting `make smoke` locally to hit the same code path if you want to reproduce quickly.
